messages.subject: Re: Order L-43196 confirmed
messages.text:
Hi Jennifer, 
 

 Sorry for the delay in responding and thank you for your patience. 
 

 Here are the steps for making a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned and attach the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s) and will request a fee of $9.99 for the exchange (only if applicable) 😊
 

 

 Chaleureusement,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-fondateur 
 Lasclay
